sources.title: Predefinição:Nre
sources.contract: Name fallback is name then nome, preserving explicit blanks. Body fallback is1,reference,content,text,referência,conteúdo,texto. Group switch selects group then grupo, with only nota/upper-alpha/upper-roman/lower-alpha/lower-greek/lower-roman accepted and lower-alpha default. In the named branch the accepted group result reads group twice, so grupo alone selects the branch but emits an empty group. This native typo is preserved by observation.
